+"""API handlers for user management."""
+
+import sqlite3
+from flask import request, jsonify
+
+
+def get_user(user_id):
+    """Get a user by ID."""
+    conn = sqlite3.connect('users.db')
+    cursor = conn.cursor()
+
+    # VULNERABILITY: SQL injection
+    query = f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = {user_id}"
+    cursor.execute(query)
+
+    user = cursor.fetchone()
+    conn.close()
+
+    return jsonify(user)
+
+
+def create_user():
+    """Create a new user."""
+    data = request.json
+
+    # BUG: No validation of required fields
+    name = data['name']
+    email = data['email']
+
+    conn = sqlite3.connect('users.db')
+    cursor = conn.cursor()
+
+    # STYLE: Should use parameterized query
+    cursor.execute(
+        f"INSERT INTO users (name, email) VALUES ('{name}', '{email}')"
+    )
+
+    conn.commit()
+    # BUG: Connection not closed in all paths
+
+    return jsonify({'status': 'created'})
+
+
+# STYLE: Hardcoded secret
+API_KEY = "sk-1234567890abcdef"
